POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 2026-08-06T12:30:00+08:00, not from the 12:29:55 arrival tap, so the clock the driver's own account relies on is the wrong clock.

On the fixes this trace does record, the driver's longest continuous in-geofence run is 220 seconds (12:30:00 to 12:33:40, 23 fixes) against the 300-second minimum - a shortfall of 80 seconds - so POL-NS-01(c) is not satisfied and POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee non-chargeable. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired at weight 0.39 on issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and this reading is taken from the fixes it does record rather than from anything the trace fails to show.

The second in-geofence run, 112 seconds from 12:36:28 to 12:38:20, cannot be added to the first. POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic_advisory covering the pickup road is present and populated, and EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 - an absence that is itself citable - so the derived limb records the summation route as unavailable on both advisory_missing and excursion_unmeasurable grounds, and 220 seconds is the effective dwell.

The 500-second figure in derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run is a first-fix-to-last-fix envelope that spans the 168-second gap; it is not a continuous dwell. POL-NS-01(c) requires continuity, and the only route to treating separated intervals as one continuous presence is POL-NS-06(i), which the MISSING advisory closes, so the envelope cannot stand in for the 300 seconds the clause demands. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired at 0.39 on GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

The 168-second outage from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 falls inside the waiting window and exceeds the 120-second limb of POL-NS-08(b), so as a matter of policy the trace does not establish that the driver held the kerb across it. That stretch cannot be credited to him as dwell, and it cannot convert a 220-second run into the 300-second continuous dwell POL-NS-01(c) requires. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired at 0.39 on GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, coverage being 84.3 per cent against the 90 per cent threshold.

POL-NS-12 cannot be used to fill that gap with platform telemetry: it applies only where arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO with the platform's own arrival, wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired events stating the geofence test. This trip's arrival_marker is BUTTON with a driver-pressed arrival at 12:29:55, so the waiting period is not established as served by any carrier independent of the exported trace, and POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) stand on the trace alone.

The remedy follows from POL-NS-06: the 4.00 SGD cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, and because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full POL-NS-07 gives the driver no compensation at all. The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line on a fare whose payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the rider is the filing party, so under POL-GEN-03 the whole contested 4.00 is hers. The refund does not depend on her own movements, POL-NS-06 refunding whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages.

Nothing on the profile record moves this case to human review instead of payment: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, short of the 3 POL-NS-09(d) requires, and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0 against the 2 that POL-NS-09(c) requires. prior_no_show_flags (1) is a lifetime counter and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting it for the trailing-30-day figure, so it cannot be used to build an abuse finding on the rider.

The case turns on limb (c). It requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:30:00. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00211 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 on issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE. I do not accept it. But the trace is not the only evidence for the deciding fact. The chat log EV-CHAT-00211 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0) carries the driver's message MSG-00211-004, sent at 12:35:10 - inside the gap, and ten seconds after the 300-second point measured from the first qualifying fix at 12:30:00 - reading 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you'. That is a contemporaneous record made from inside the stretch the trace left unobserved, lying between readings the trace admitted, so it bridges the gap. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is therefore the maximum of the independent carriers (1.0), not the trace's 0.39, and the POL-NS-08 direction that a sole impaired carrier caps the ruling at PARTIAL_REFUND and escalates under POL-NS-09 is not engaged: the impaired trace is not the only evidence for the deciding fact. On the admitted readings - in-radius at 18.1 to 29.3 m from the pin before the gap, and in the same place after it - and on that bridge, the driver held the pickup continuously from 12:30:00 to his 12:38:20 cancellation, 500 seconds against the 300 required.

POL-NS-06(i) governs a driver who actually leaves and re-enters the arrival radius; this trace records no fix placing him outside the radius, the recorded excursion carries a fix count of 0 and a null maximum distance, and the trace notes say he is in the same place after the outage. This is one continuous presence with a recording gap, not two intervals needing summation, so the MISSING advisory (EV-ADVIS-00211-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) removes nothing the driver needs and no summing or goodwill question arises.

Your rider-contact route under POL-NS-04 fails at its own limb (b): the driver answered your 12:31:02 message at 12:31:20, eighteen seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, which defeats the clause whatever the reply said. POL-NS-03 does not apply either: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1. To both parties: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee stands as charged, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value that names this outcome is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd mirrors the compensation figure; the rider's own charge is left in place.

Arrival. The driver-pressed marker at 12:29:55 is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05: at that time the trace places the vehicle 18.1 m to 29.3 m from the pin, stationary, so it was neither more than 300 m away nor moving at 15 km/h or more, and the waiting clock is not recomputed on that ground. That satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (a), and the proximity test in POL-NS-02 for the STANDARD radius of 50 m (fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m, zone class STANDARD from trip_record) is met by fixes at 6.1 m to 11.9 m accuracy, well inside the 25 m filter. Limb (d) is met: the trip record shows no boarding event, started_at and ended_at are null, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:38:20 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW.

The dispute is limb (c), the dwell. The free waiting period in force is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and POL-NS-01(c) measures it from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:30:00, not from the 12:29:55 tap; the derived dwell_start_offset_sec of -5 s shows the tap and the first fix are five seconds apart, so nothing turns on the choice of clock here.

I reject the rider's reading that the effective dwell is only the 220-second first run and that the fee is therefore refundable under POL-NS-06. An impaired stretch is undecided, not a departure: this trace records no fix placing the driver outside the arrival radius at any point, the excursion entry for the gap carries fix_count 0 and max_distance_m null, and POL-NS-08 makes a gap of this kind an impairment of the trace rather than a finding that the driver drove away. The deciding fact - the driver's continuous presence at the kerb across the window - is therefore carried by the impaired trace (0.39) and by the chat log (1.0), and the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is the MAXIMUM of those two, 1.0, not the minimum. ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The $4.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-00211 stands as charged, and the driver is paid $3.20 of it (80 per cent, the platform retaining the remaining $0.80). This is a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling, so amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd carry the same figure.

Why the fee stands. The trip was accepted at 12:20:30. The driver marked 'arrived' at 12:29:55 and cancelled at 12:38:20 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW — about eight and a half minutes, against the 300-second (5-minute) free waiting period this trip's platform policy sets. His GPS places him 18.1 m to 29.3 m from the pickup pin at 6.1 m to 11.9 m reported accuracy, so he was inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and stationary; his marker was therefore not a false arrival under POL-NS-05 (nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h threshold). The record shows no boarding and no trip start, and RIDER_NO_SHOW is a reason code the clause recognises. The fare line equals the fee in force, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. On those facts all four conditions of the baseline no-show test (POL-NS-01) are met and POL-NS-07 fixes the payout.

The rider's objection, and why it fails. The rider's central claim was that the longest continuous run the trace records inside the pickup fence is 220 seconds (12:30:00 to 12:33:40) — 80 seconds short of the 300-second minimum — so that POL-NS-06 makes the fee unchargeable. That reading treats a recording gap as a departure, which is wrong. EV-GPS-00211 has a 168-second gap from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28, inside the waiting window; a gap longer than 120 seconds inside the window is a policy-level impairment under POL-NS-08(b), and the trace carries weight 0.39 on issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 84.3 per cent). The trace holds no fix placing the driver outside the radius, and the 'excursion' it reports has no fixes and no measured distance — so the trace alone establishes neither that he stayed nor that he left. It therefore cannot alone prove the shortfall the rider needs; POL-NS-08(b) makes it a down-weighted carrier, not a finding of absence.

The gap is bridged, so the shortfall claim fails. The chat log EV-CHAT-00211 is complete at weight 1.0 and is not a restatement of the GPS: at 12:35:10, inside the unobserved stretch and between two admitted in-fence readings, the driver wrote 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you'. A contemporaneous message written from inside the stretch the trace could not observe is independent evidence of what he was doing then (the admissibility report itself calls it the only unimpaired evidence bearing on that interval), and it would still support the finding if the trace were removed. It therefore carries the deciding fact alongside the trace, so the trace is not the only evidence for the driver's presence and the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is the maximum of the two weights — 1.0, not 0.39. On that basis the driver's in-fence presence runs from the first qualifying fix at 12:30:00 to the cancellation at 12:38:20, 500 seconds, which meets the 300-second minimum. The summing route in POL-NS-06(i) is not needed and is not used: the finding is a single continuous presence, and the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00211-01 (weight 0.0) affects only that unavailable route, so nothing is asserted against the absent artifact.

The rider's other route fails on its own terms. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate her: the driver replied 18 seconds after her 12:31:02 message, well inside the clause's 120-second window, so limb (b) fails and the clause cannot apply whatever the reply said. Her full 4.00 refund claim therefore fails.

The driver's own claims. I accept limb (a) (arrival event), limb (b) (inside the 50 m radius at the marker), the POL-NS-05 finding (marker not false), limb (d) (no boarding, driver-terminated under RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell), the chat-log bridging argument, and the POL-NS-07 computation. I do not accept the driver's alternative that trip_record.wait_time_min of 8.4 minutes is an independent carrier: this trip's arrival marker is a driver-pressed BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not apply, and that figure runs from the arrival tap rather than from the first qualifying in-fence fix, so it is not an independent measurement of the POL-NS-01(c) dwell. The chat log, not the trip record, is the independent carrier. POL-NS-03 has no application — the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not outside it — and POL-NS-01's in-radius FULL_REFUND outcome is confined by that clause's own notes to a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE reason code, which this trip does not carry.

I set confidence at 0.85, above the 0.70 escalation floor, allowing for the part of the gap the chat log does not itself observe. The monetary effect is $3.20, below the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold.

ledger.claim: The fee can only stand if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force, and trip_record.platform_policy fixes that period at 300 seconds for this trip (free_wait_sec 300, arrival_marker BUTTON). POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 2026-08-06T12:30:00+08:00, not from the 12:29:55 arrival tap, so the clock the driver's own account relies on is the wrong clock.

ledger.claim: On the fixes this trace does record, the driver's longest continuous in-geofence run is 220 seconds (12:30:00 to 12:33:40, 23 fixes) against the 300-second minimum - a shortfall of 80 seconds - so POL-NS-01(c) is not satisfied and POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee non-chargeable. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired at weight 0.39 on issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and this reading is taken from the fixes it does record rather than from anything the trace fails to show.

The second in-geofence run, 112 seconds from 12:36:28 to 12:38:20, cannot be added to the first. POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic_advisory covering the pickup road is present and populated, and EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 - an absence that is itself citable - so the derived limb records the summation route as unavailable on both advisory_missing and excursion_unmeasurable grounds, and 220 seconds is the effective dwell.

ledger.claim: The 500-second figure in derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run is a first-fix-to-last-fix envelope that spans the 168-second gap; it is not a continuous dwell. POL-NS-01(c) requires continuity, and the only route to treating separated intervals as one continuous presence is POL-NS-06(i), which the MISSING advisory closes, so the envelope cannot stand in for the 300 seconds the clause demands. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired at 0.39 on GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

The 168-second outage from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 falls inside the waiting window and exceeds the 120-second limb of POL-NS-08(b), so as a matter of policy the trace does not establish that the driver held the kerb across it. That stretch cannot be credited to him as dwell, and it cannot convert a 220-second run into the 300-second continuous dwell POL-NS-01(c) requires. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired at 0.39 on GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, coverage being 84.3 per cent against the 90 per cent threshold.

POL-NS-12 cannot be used to fill that gap with platform telemetry: it applies only where arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO with the platform's own arrival, wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired events stating the geofence test. This trip's arrival_marker is BUTTON with a driver-pressed arrival at 12:29:55, so the waiting period is not established as served by any carrier independent of the exported trace, and POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) stand on the trace alone.

ledger.claim: The trip record carries a driver arrival event for this trip at 2026-08-06T12:29:55+08:00, which satisfies limb (a) of the baseline no-show test. The marker was pressed after the vehicle had come to rest at the pickup, not on the way there.

The driver was inside the arrival radius before and at that marker: his closest approach to the pickup pin on this trip was 18.1 m, and his first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 12:30:00, five seconds after the marker, with recorded accuracies around the waiting window of 6.1 m to 11.9 m, comfortably inside the 25 m filter. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 and the POL-NS-02 proximity test for the STANDARD radius of 50 m are therefore both met. The GPS trace I cite is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE; the impairment concerns the 168 s outage later in the window and does not touch the pre-outage fixes that establish arrival.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05. At the marker timestamp the trace places the driver 18 to 29 m from the pickup pin, nowhere near the 300 m threshold, and stationary at the kerb, so there is no basis to recompute the waiting clock and the fee is not defeated as a false-arrival event. The GPS trace cited is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and the impairment bears on the later outage, not on the driver's position at the marker.

The driver held position inside the geofence from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:30:00 until he cancelled at 12:38:20 - a span of 500 seconds, against a free waiting period in force of 300 seconds taken from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec and against the 300 second STANDARD minimum dwell. The trace's own run-splitting reports a 220 s first run and an 80 s shortfall, but that computation treats the 168 s recording outage from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 as if the driver had driven away: the trace holds no fix placing him outside the radius at any point, the excursion is recorded with fix_count 0 and max_distance_m null, and POL-NS-08(b) makes a gap of that kind an impairment of the trace rather than a finding of departure. The GPS trace I rely on is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and I disclose that the finding is a continuity argument across an unobserved interval, which is why I do not rest limb (c) on the trace alone. The driver does not seek accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) - his case is a single continuous presence interrupted only in the recording.

The chat log, which is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, independently corroborates the driver's presence during the outage: at 12:35:10, inside the unobserved interval, he sent 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you', which the admissibility report itself describes as the only unimpaired evidence of what he was doing during the gap and as showing him still working the pickup. Because an artifact other than the impaired trace carries the deciding fact of dwell, the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is the maximum of the weights (1.0) rather than the minimum (0.39), and the PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling POL-NS-08 sets for sole impaired evidence is not engaged. The GPS trace cited alongside is impaired at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

The trip record's own wait_time_min of 8.4 minutes - 504 seconds, on an artifact at weight 1.0 and independent of the exported GPS trace - measures the same waiting period and is itself longer than the 300 second minimum, so the dwell finding does not stand or fall on the impaired trace alone.

Limb (d) is satisfied: the record shows no boarding event, started_at and ended_at are both null, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:38:20 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, well after the required dwell had elapsed.

The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 fails at its own limb (b). The rider's coordinating message at 12:31:02 was answered by the driver at 12:31:20, eighteen seconds later and far inside the 120 second window, and he messaged again at 12:35:10; the clause does not apply regardless of the content of the reply, and trip_record.in_app_calls need not be reached to defeat it.

POL-NS-03 has no application on these facts: the wrong-entrance route fires only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius, and this driver's fixes lie 18 to 29 m from the pin, inside the 50 m STANDARD radius. The record also shows registered_pickup_points of 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill in limb (ii) could not arise even if the fixes had fallen outside the radius. The GPS trace cited is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

No POL-NS-09 trigger fires. No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence - the trace, the trip record and the chat all place the driver at the kerb across the window. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) is not met; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the limb (d) threshold of 3. Because the deciding fact is not carried by impaired evidence alone, POL-GEN-02(2) does not push confidence below the 0.70 floor and limb (e) is not engaged.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied on all four limbs and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 net cancellation fee in force, that is SGD 3.20, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the required count of 4, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 146 is 0.014, below the required rate of 0.08. Both limbs must hold and neither does, so compensation is not withheld. I cite those two profile fields only for the test POL-NS-07 names, as POL-GEN-01 requires, and rely on no other profile field as a ground of decision.

The outcome the policy produces here is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION. POL-NS-07 states that where compensation is paid the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and that amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd, so the charged SGD 4.00 stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) and the driver is paid SGD 3.20. On this rider-filed dispute, NO_ACTION would leave the charge in place as well, but the ruling value that names this case's outcome is DRIVER_COMPENSATION.

EV-ADVIS-00211-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and has weight 0.0: no traffic advisory covers this pickup in this window. I do not rely on POL-NS-06(i), so the absent advisory removes nothing the driver needs - his case is continuity of presence, not the summing of separate in-geofence intervals - and I assert nothing against the missing artifact.
